label: Sample: made-up battery test
made: generated: cycle 1 to 168, capacity_ah falling in a straight line from 1.86 at cycle 1 to 1.29 at cycle 168, rounded to 3 decimals
why_not_nasa: NASA's dataset page (https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/li-ion-battery-aging-datasets) lists no data file and says "License not specified"; the only download NASA links (from https://www.nasa.gov/intelligent-systems-division/discovery-and-systems-health/pcoe/pcoe-data-set-repository/) is on phm-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com, not a nasa.gov address
limit_from: https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/li-ion-battery-aging-datasets: end of life at a 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2 Ah to 1.4 Ah
